messages.text: The game started beeping when I find a pair. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Removed the beeps for both matched pairs and the final pair in [use-game.ts](/work/src/game/session/use-game.ts). Matching, victory feedback, and the rest of the game logic remain intact.

Type checking, all 138 unit and static tests, and the production build passed. The silent-play browser test passed; the browser suite had one unrelated face-image test time out, and that test passed when rerun on its own.

The full formatting check still flags three unrelated files. The changed file passes formatting.
